in_sanskrit.name: वंशकृष्ण
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: वंश (vamsha) meaning lineage, कृष्ण (krishna) meaning Krishna

in_marathi.name: Vamshakrishna
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vamshakrishna हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vamshakrishna is derived from two Sanskrit words - 'Vamsha' meaning message or instruction and 'Krishna' meaning God or divine. This name signifies that the bearer of this name carries the divine message or instruction of God. In Hindu mythology, Lord Krishna is known for his divine guidance and wisdom. Therefore, the name Vamshakrishna is believed to bestow the bearer with wisdom, knowledge, and the ability to spread the message of truth and righteousness.
